mutations.because: Dropping the distinct-count check lets a fourth scene through timelineProblem, so the 4-distinct test must fail.
Dropping background from toBrief's beat rebuild strips a loaded brief's scenes on save, so the fromBrief → toBrief round-trip test must fail.
Reading the floor block off any timelineProblem failure (here, the scene cap too) re-blocks Add beat on a pre-existing over-cap draft, so the 4-scene test must fail.
Letting fromBrief keep any defined background restores a snapshot's empty or non-string scene into the draft, so the recovered-snapshot repair test must fail.
